meta.title: NOKI SERVICE — Operating platform for COD e-commerce
meta.description: NOKI SERVICE centralizes orders, confirmation, stock, fulfillment, delivery and COD remittances in one operating platform.

hero.title: Run your entire COD cycle from a single platform.
hero.subtitle: Orders, confirmation, stock, fulfillment, delivery, cash and remittances brought together in one structured operating platform.

problem.title: COD operations are still fragmented
problem.intro: Cash-on-delivery selling often relies on spreadsheets, manual calls and several disconnected tools, with no reliable overview of a single order.

points.title: Scattered tools
points.description: Orders, stock and delivery are tracked separately, multiplying re-entry work and errors.

points.title: Manual cash reconciliation
points.description: Tracking collections and seller remittances often happens outside any system, causing delays and approximations.

points.title: Limited real-time visibility
points.description: Without a unified view of the order cycle, anticipating delays or delivery incidents is difficult.

about.title: An operating platform built for COD e-commerce
about.body: NOKI SERVICE centralizes order tracking, from creation to collection, within an architecture structured by organization, country and role. The platform is designed to give teams a single source of truth for operations.

cycle.title: A structured, end-to-end order cycle
cycle.intro: Every order follows a defined, traceable cycle within the platform.

steps.title: Order received
steps.description: The order is registered and attached to an organization and a country.

steps.title: Confirmation
steps.description: The order is verified before it enters fulfillment.

steps.title: Warehouse fulfillment
steps.description: Items are reserved, picked and then packed.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: The order is handed over and tracked through to delivery.

steps.title: Collection & remittance
steps.description: The cash-on-delivery payment is recorded, then remitted to the seller through a multi-step validation process.

modules.title: Core modules
modules.intro: An operating foundation structured around the real needs of cash-on-delivery e-commerce.

items.title: End-to-end orders
items.description: Full order lifecycle, from creation to delivery.

items.title: Stock & warehouses
items.description: Tracking of warehouses, reservations and stock levels.

items.title: Fulfillment & dispatch
items.description: Picking and packing steps before handover to the carrier.

items.title: Delivery tracking
items.description: Tracking of delivery runs and delivery attempts.

items.title: Cash on delivery (COD)
items.description: Recording of collections made at the point of delivery.

items.title: Seller remittances
items.description: Remittance batches subject to a multi-step validation process.

items.title: Roles & permissions
items.description: Role-based access control, scoped by organization and country.

items.title: Advanced relationship-based authorization
items.description: An additional authorization engine for finer-grained access rules.

items.title: Supervised automation
items.description: Automation of repetitive tasks, always subject to human validation before any sensitive action.

security.title: Security and governance
security.intro: The platform is structured around access control and traceability principles.

points.title: Roles & permissions
points.description: Every access relies on a defined role and a defined set of permissions.

points.title: Contextual access
points.description: Access rights take the relevant organization and country into account.

points.title: Traceability of actions
points.description: Important actions are logged together with their context.

points.title: Multi-step validation
points.description: Sensitive financial operations follow a multi-step validation process before execution.

automation.title: Supervised automation
automation.body: NOKI SERVICE plans to progressively automate repetitive tasks across the operating cycle, while keeping mandatory human validation before any sensitive action.
automation.disclaimer: This automation is in progress and will be introduced progressively, under human supervision.

multiCountry.title: Multi-country and multi-currency
multiCountry.body: NOKI SERVICE's architecture is designed to operate across multiple countries and currencies within a single organization.

points.title: Multi-organization
points.description: Each organization has its own data scope.

points.title: Multi-country
points.description: The platform is designed to cover several countries of operation.

points.title: Multi-currency
points.description: Amounts are attached to a currency per transaction.

demo.title: Request a demo
demo.body: Want to learn more about NOKI SERVICE?
demo.note: The demo request channel will be activated soon.

items.question: What is NOKI SERVICE?
items.answer: NOKI SERVICE is an operating platform that centralizes the management of cash-on-delivery orders, from creation through to remittance to the seller.

items.question: Is the platform available today?
items.answer: This site presents the foundation of the platform. Operational access and rollout details will be communicated at a later stage.

items.question: Do you offer an online store builder?
items.answer: No. NOKI SERVICE is not a store builder and does not offer a "My store" feature.

items.question: How can I contact you?
items.answer: The demo request and contact channel will be activated soon.

items.question: Which countries does NOKI SERVICE operate in?
items.answer: The platform is designed to operate across multiple countries. The list of countries actually covered will be communicated at a later stage.
